notes.title: Going free
notes.content: With the recent Unity Runtime Fee being announced it will affect this title, it will be made free.

notes.title: Share screenhots of your digging
notes.content:
We would love to see your screenshots of the digging you have done in-game, see a sample of ours here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1828512476

notes.title: Update incoming.
notes.content:
You will have noticed an update was published.

This includes:
-Adjusted health loss calculation if falling/jumping from big height.
-Egypt level:Fixed some scripting/materials not showing correctly in cave areas.
-Added option to stop sand/dune slow reset, gives unlimited time to dig without loosing current progress(sand growing back slowly), sand does not reset at all. To access: While in game, press the Escape key, on menu there is a button at bottom of menu to turn this on/off.

Please do not hesitate to provide feedback or have questions.

notes.title: Update incoming
notes.content:
Hi,

Watch out for an update coming soon, this includes some improvements and also better lighting effects.

Please do let us know if you have any comments / feedback.

notes.title: Enabled discount now for the Christmas / New Year period.
notes.content: Apologies that this is a bit late, have been able to enable a discount now for the Christmas / New Year period, lasts 10 days.

notes.title: Update published
notes.content: This includes adjusted low camera angle settings (e.g. to be able to look upwards), improved minimap option (use minimap that follows the player for map reference assist), improved low/high quality settings kept between multiple cameras.

notes.title: Minor update published
notes.content: Minor update published, includes adjusted camera/dig settings to make for a better experience where digging [continuous mode with mouse down] occurs very close/further away to player. Added Mouse Y axis invert option (Press I key to invert).
